summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas but needs targeted refinement of immune subtype resolution, acinar/REG marker separation, epsilon markers, and redundant contrast axes.

issues.description: The immune compartment is present but over-collapsed: T and NK/cytotoxic lymphocytes share one axis, B and plasma cells share one axis, and macrophage/monocyte/APC signal is a single myeloid axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Add targeted refinement modules/axes for T cell versus NK/cytotoxic lymphocyte, B cell versus plasma cell, and, if supported by the cited atlas resources, macrophage/monocyte versus dendritic/APC-enriched myeloid. These can be gated by the existing broad immune modules.

issues.description: REG1A and REG3A appear in the baseline acinar module and the REG-positive acinar state module, making the state axis partly duplicate acinar identity instead of isolating a REG-high state.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep REG genes concentrated in reg_positive_acinar_state and replace REG1A/REG3A in acinar_secretory with additional canonical digestive enzyme/acinar markers supported by the pancreas resources.

issues.description: The epsilon module has only two genes and MLN is not a strong canonical adult pancreatic epsilon-cell marker compared with ghrelin-centered epsilon identity, making the rare-cell axis fragile.
issues.suggested_fix: Rework epsilon_cell around supported human pancreatic ghrelin/epsilon markers, or keep it as a conservative rare-cell axis with a more defensible small gene set.

issues.description: These contrast axes are redundant with plain identity axes and do not encode clearly opposing biological programs; endothelial and mural cells are vascular partners rather than opposite ends of one state axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove these contrast axes unless replacing them with a clearly justified biological gradient; use dimensionality for supported subtype/state resolution instead.

out_of_scope: DOI and impact-factor verification were not repeated because citation validation is outside this discriminator pass.
